bericht:
pip hole closed (PEP 668).
- symptom: research-entity-verify died 3.8s in step "Install validation runtime", rc=1, 17 steps SKIPPED. looked like a verdict, was not.
- cause: ubuntu 24.04 system python is externally-managed. actions/setup-python on hosted runners gives an OWN interpreter where pip may write; our replacement only symlinked python3/pip3 -> every `pip install` refused.
- scope: 9 of 10 armed RAE gates pip install. would have posted false red on up to 103 PRs.
- fix: yml2sh.py setup-python replacement now builds `python3 -m venv --system-site-packages $RUNNER_TEMP/setup-python/venv` and puts it on PATH (VIRTUAL_ENV set). --system-site-packages keeps yaml & co visible, so nothing that worked before breaks. symlink path kept as fallback.
- proof: same gate, PR 232 0e2b3a54, 8.3s: Install validation runtime ENDE(0), Compile Python entrypoints ENDE(0), Validate Claude hook settings JSON ENDE(0), then substantive fail at "Validate project research triggers" -> "trigger rename clay -> clayresearch missing". that is a verdict.
- 3 false reds removed from zustand.json (backup zustand.vor-venv-fix.json), the 3 commit statuses set to pending with description ZURUECKGEZOGEN.
- NOT yet rolled out to the Dr.-Unterweger instance (/root/frank-laeufer/yml2sh.py unchanged) — its 20 gates would all be regenerated, wants its own test.
